runs.text: The document does not report a specific capacity in mAh/g for the strained V2O5 films. Its text and figures give no capacity value.
The galvanostatic charge-discharge testing, which is where a capacity would come from, is only referred to the Supporting Information:

runs.quote: voltammetry cycling is provided in the Supporting Information

runs.text: (Figures S12 and S13). That material is not part of this document. The main-text results on the strained films are cyclic voltammetry, with peak potentials and diffusion coefficient ratios, not capacity figures.
